body.x: Bisecuwill showcase the Bisecu Smart Bicycle at CES 2019, the world's largesttechnology exhibition, held in Las Vegas, USA, from January 8 (Tue) to 11(Fri).

Bisecu is a start-up that develops and manufactures the world's first fully automatic smart bicycle lock. It provides a smarter and more convenient bike experience for cyclists around the world. Through two years of research, Bisecu has developed the most technologically advanced smart bicycle lock, and maximized user convenience through full automation using smart phone. The first mass production of the first generation product has recently been carried out, and the second generation product is under development.

Themain features of the Bisecu smart bike lock are: △ Automatic lock controlfunction using smart phone app △ Real time driving data display and recordingby sensor during driving △ The lightest smart lock in the world △ Patentedlocking system △ Sharing function through app

Meanwhile, 'CES', the largest IT exhibition in the world, is an exhibition where one can grasp the flow of the home electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. AVING NEWS, a global news network that most reported the issues of CES, MWC and IFA, the world's top three tech exhibitions over the last twelve years, has sent a special report team to CES this year to report major issues in the world market, and introduce major Korean companies to the world.
